content_sections.heading: NBPGR Young Professional-I Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the NBPGR Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download NBPGR Young Professional-I Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Young Professional-I: Graduate in Science/ Commerce /Computer (with minimum 60% marks) from a recognized University/ College. Minimum two years' experience in the field of agriculture/ Computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Power Point, etc.)

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Young Professional-I: Minimum Age: 21 years, Maximum Age: 45 years. Age relaxations apply: SC/ST/female: 5 years, Differently Abled: up to 10 years, OBC (non-creamy layer): 3 years.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NBPGR Young Professional-I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: NBPGR Young Professional-I Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (NBPGR) for filling vacant contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in NBPGR recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post is Young Professional-I under research field category based in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Young Professional-I position in this notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate in Science, Commerce, or Computer with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognized university or college.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years and the maximum age limit is 45 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Young Professional-I post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for NBPGR recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to submit any prior online applications.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 12th October 2026 at the designated venue in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the Committee Room, Room no. 2, Division of Germplasm Evaluation, ICAR-NBPGR (Old Building), New Delhi - 110012.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled application form, original copies of educational and experience certificates, identity proof, and self-attested photocopies for document verification.
